canonical.title: San Diego Weekend: Michelin Dinner + What to Do

sources.title: Michelin-starred restaurants in California — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Addison holds 3 Michelin stars; no 2-star tier exists in San Diego

sources.title: Addison Restaurant
sources.claim: Southern California's only 3-star Michelin restaurant at Fairmont Grand Del Mar, Del Mar

sources.title: Addison — The Experience
sources.claim: $395/person 10-course tasting menu; $198/person Champagne Lounge walk-in

sources.title: Addison Reservations
sources.claim: Reservation slots release sporadically; cancellations surface on Instagram

sources.title: Addison renovation 2026 — Sandiegoville
sources.claim: Addison closed April 1, reopened May 19, 2026 with new Champagne Lounge and refreshed dining room

sources.title: Valle Restaurant
sources.claim: Oceanfront in Oceanside; contemporary Mexican with Baja wines

sources.title: Valle — Tierra y Mar Menu
sources.claim: Seasonal tasting menu $220++/person; concise tasting $140++

sources.title: Chef Roberto Alcocer profile — San Diego Magazine
sources.claim: 25+ years across Baja, France, Spain; 2025 James Beard Award semifinalist

sources.title: Lilo Restaurant — Robb Report
sources.claim: 22-seat tasting menu in a converted boogie board factory in Carlsbad

sources.title: Lilo Michelin star — Hoodline
sources.claim: Lilo pairings: traditional $190, Champagne $290, non-alcoholic $110; earned star 10 weeks after opening

sources.title: Jeune et Jolie — Visit Carlsbad
sources.claim: 4-course prix fixe $105–$120/person; walk-in bar menu available

sources.title: Soichi — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: 1-star intimate omakase in University Heights; ingredients sourced from Japan

sources.title: San Diego Michelin restaurants — sandiego.org
sources.claim: Five Michelin-starred establishments; Addison is the only 3-star in Southern California

sources.title: Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve
sources.claim: $15–25/vehicle, open daily 7am–sunset; Guy Fleming (0.7mi), Razor Point (1.3mi), Beach Trail (0.75mi)

sources.title: La Jolla Kayak — Sea Cave Tour
sources.claim: Guided 90–120 min sea-cave tour departing daily 9am; includes helmet, PFD, instruction

sources.title: La Jolla Sea Cave Kayak Tours
sources.claim: Tours from $64/kayak; tandem $74–$119 depending on operator/season

sources.title: San Diego Zoo
sources.claim: 2026: $78 adult gate, $70 online; includes Skyfari, Guided Bus Tour, all shows

sources.title: Balboa Park Explorer Pass
sources.claim: $75 adult / $50 youth (7-day Parkwide, 16 museums + IMAX); excludes Zoo

sources.title: Balboa Park Explorer Pass — purchase
sources.claim: Parkwide $75 adult, Limited $63 adult, Annual from $109

sources.title: USS Midway Museum
sources.claim: $39 online / $41 door for adults 13+; includes audio tour

sources.title: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park
sources.claim: Free admission; free ranger tours daily at 11am and 2pm

sources.title: Gaslamp Quarter — sandiego.org
sources.claim: Largest collection of Victorian commercial buildings in US; 100 historic buildings in 16.5 walkable blocks

sources.title: Cabrillo National Monument
sources.claim: $20/vehicle, $10/pedestrian, open 9am–5pm

sources.title: Best time to visit San Diego — La Jolla Mom
sources.claim: September–October is the sweet spot: warm 70s, swimmable ocean, thin crowds; May–June has marine layer (June Gloom)

sources.title: San Diego Beaches Guide — La Jolla Mom
sources.claim: La Jolla Cove: protected marine reserve, best for snorkeling/seals; La Jolla Shores: best for families and beginner surfers

sources.title: Hotel del Coronado awards
sources.claim: Coronado Beach named in Dr. Beach Top Ten every year 2016–2024; Travel + Leisure 25 Best U.S. Beaches 2020, 2022, 2024, 2025

sources.title: San Diego beaches — Quirky Travel Guy
sources.claim: Sunset Cliffs: premier sunset-viewing, rugged sandstone, legendary surf; Ocean Beach: most beginner-friendly surf area

sources.title: Torrey Pines trail guide — SD Beach Review
sources.claim: Torrey Pines parking ~$20/vehicle; open daily 7am–sunset

sources.title: San Diego Zoo discount tickets — La Jolla Mom
sources.claim: Gate: $78 adult / $68 child; online: $70/$60

sources.title: Surf spots San Diego — sandiego.org
sources.claim: La Jolla Shores top beginner spot; Tourmaline Surf Park forgiving; Law Street near Crystal Pier also good for learners
